parameters.help_en: The baseline ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 基线的ID, 可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html 获取
parameters.name: baseline_id

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID, 可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html 获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the baseline owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The priority of the baseline. Valid values: {1,3,5,7,8}
parameters.help_zh: 基线的优先级，取值范围为{1,3,5,7,8}
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The ancestor nodes of nodes in the baseline. Separate the ancestor nodes with commas (,). If a large number of ancestor nodes exist, we recommend that you create a zero load node and configure the zero load node as the descendant node of nodes in the baseline to facilitate node management
parameters.help_zh: 基线上游节点列表，使用逗号分割，节点较多的情况下，建议在其下游增加虚节点，便于管理
parameters.name: node_ids

fields.help_en: The cycle that corresponds to the committed completion time. For a day-level baseline, set this parameter to 1. For an hour-level baseline, set this parameter to a value that is no more than 24
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间对应的周期，天基线是1，小时基线可以配置最多24个周期
fields.name: cycle

fields.help_en: The committed completion time in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,47]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间，hh:mm格式，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]
fields.name: time

parameters.help_en: The settings of the committed completion time of the baseline
parameters.name: overtime_settings

parameters.help_en: The alert margin threshold of the baseline. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 基线预警余量，单位为分钟
parameters.name: alert_margin_threshold

parameters.help_en: The type of the baseline. Valid values: DAILY and HOURLY
parameters.help_zh: 基线类型，包括DAILY（天基线）和HOURLY（小时基线）
parameters.name: baseline_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the baseline. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 基线是否开启，包括true（可用）和false（不可用）
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the alerting feature. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启告警，包括true（开启）和false（关闭）
parameters.name: alert_enabled

fields.help_en: The interval at which an event alert notification is sent. Unit: minutes. Minimum value: 5. Maximum value: 1,440
fields.help_zh: 事件告警间隔，单位为分钟，最小为5，最大值为 1440
fields.name: alert_interval

fields.help_en: The maximum number of times an event alert notification is sent. Maximum value: 24
fields.help_zh: 事件告警最大次数，最大为24
fields.name: alert_maximum

fields.help_en: The alert notification methods. Valid values: MAIL, SMS, PHONE, DINGROBOTS, and Webhooks. The value MAIL indicates that alert notifications are sent by email. The value SMS indicates that alert notifications are sent by text message. The value PHONE indicates that alert notifications are sent by phone call. You can use this notification method only in DataWorks Professional Edition or a more advanced edition. The value DINGROBOTS indicates that alert notifications are sent by using a DingTalk chatbot. You can use this notification method only if the RobotUrls parameter is configured. The value Webhooks indicates that alert notifications are sent by WeCom or Lark. You can use this notification method only if the Webhooks parameter is configured
fields.help_zh:
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
PHONE（电话），仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持使用电话方式接收报警。
DINGROBOTS（钉钉机器人），仅当配置RobotUrls参数后，该报警方式才会生效。
Webhooks（企业微信或飞书机器人），仅当配置 Webhooks 参数后，该报警方式才会生效
fields.name: alert_methods

fields.help_en: The details of the alert recipient. If you set AlertRecipientType to OWNER, leave this parameter empty. If you set AlertRecipientType to SHIFT_SCHEDULE, set this parameter to the name of the shift schedule. If you set AlertRecipientType to OTHER, set this parameter to the employee IDs of specified personnel
fields.help_zh: 告警接收人详情，指定人：工号列表，值班表：值班表名，责任人：空
fields.name: alert_recipient

fields.help_en: The type of the alert recipient. Valid values: OWNER, OTHER, and SHIFT_SCHEDULE. The value OWNER indicates the node owner. The value OTHER indicates specified personnel. The value SHIFT_SCHEDULE indicates personnel in a shift schedule
fields.help_zh: 告警接收人类型，OWNER（任务责任人）/ OTHER（指定的人）/ SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）
fields.name: alert_recipient_type

fields.help_en: The type of the alert. Valid values: BASELINE and TOPIC. The value BASELINE indicates a baseline alert. The value TOPIC indicates an event alert
fields.help_zh: 告警类型，BASELINE - 基线 / TOPIC - 事件
fields.name: alert_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the baseline alerting feature. This feature is specific to baselines. Valid values: true and false
fields.help_zh: 基线告警开关，基线特有配置，包括true（是）和false（否）
fields.name: baseline_alert_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to remind all members by using the at sign (@). Valid values: true and false
fields.help_zh: 是否@所有人，包括true（是）和false（否）
fields.name: at_all

fields.help_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot
fields.name: web_url

fields.help_en: The types of event alerts, which are event-specific configurations
fields.help_zh: 事件告警类型，事件特有配置
fields.name: topic_types

parameters.help_en: The alert settings of the baseline
parameters.name: alert_settings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node that you want to disassociate from the baseline. You can specify multiple node IDs. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要从基线上提出的节点ID，多个ID间使用,分隔
parameters.name: remove_node_ids

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the baseline was updated

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
